title: Odd-majority Fourier norm and influence
statement: For every nonnegative integer $m$, the Fourier one-norm of the real-valued majority function on $2m+1$ sign coordinates equals $\mathbb{E}[1/(2J+1)](2m+1)2^m I_m$, where $J$ has the binomial distribution with parameters $m$ and $1/2$, and $I_m=\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$.
